targets.description: Per-target overrides keyed by target name.

allow_includes.description: A list of targets this target may include without linking, or true, which means this target may include anything.

allow_links.description: A list of targets this target may link without including, or true, which means this target may link to anything.

interface_allow_includes.description: If true, lwyi will allow users of this target to include it without linking to it.

interface_allow_links.description: If true, lwyi will allow users of this target to link to it without including it.

interface_include_prefixes.description: Additional interface include prefixes for this target.
